_doc: Recordings manifest: every source file of the film soundtrack. audio/fetch.py downloads them into audio/assets/ (gitignored), verifies sha256 and converts the Iowa AIFFs to FLAC cut from attack - 5 ms at 48 kHz. Note names: s = sharp (Fs4 = F#4), flats as on the Iowa site are renamed (Gb -> Fs). Pitches are the sounding pitch, as named by the Iowa site (checked by FFT on A6 crotale, D4 vibraphone, A5 / C5 bells).
